description.narrative: This Country Programming Framework (CP) is designed to enhance UNIDO#s support to the Government of Mozambique to implement a road-map towards sustainable industrialization of the economy. In doing this, UNIDO has aligned the priorities for Mozambique to the Action Plan for Reducing Poverty (PARP in the Portuguese acronym) 2011-2014, the UNDAF 2012-2015 and the country#s Agenda 2025 that aims to propel Mozambique into middle income country by 2025, building on the achievements of past projects and programmes. As industrialization is a long-term endeavor, involving many stakeholders, efforts will be made to strengthen synergies and minimize duplication by collaborating with sister agencies, development cooperation partners, state and non-state actors, as well as the private sector in the country. Mozambique is a pilot country for DaO. As part of enforcing the Delivering as One principles, (DaO), a code of conduct for the country team has been concluded and this requires agencies to mobilize their agency funding at country level through the One Fund, with the leadership of the resident coordinator. The proposed programme is part of the United Nations Development Assistance Framework (UNDAF) 2012-2015, which was developed with the Government of Mozambique in dialogue with civil society and development partners
